title: [CQ-M06] Rollout integration and hardening
description:
Objective: Own complete multi-package/platform regression, matched pilot assessment, documentation sweep and promotion decision.

Deliverable: Rollout integration and hardening. This is task M06 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): M05.
definitionOfDone: All six workstreams compose without stale-revision/check/recipe/isolation bypasses.
Report 50% planner and 30% retrieval targets plus accepted-change cost/time/quality; do not claim unmeasured savings.
Record promotion or non-promotion and unsupported hardware honestly; skipped real-VM tests do not certify support.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.content:
Hand-off from CQ-M05 (task-c53999b2) round 2. That round changed no bytes, and the landed completion edc04736 is unchanged.

1. Docs facts your sweep may not have listed:
- M05 added codeName EXECUTION_PROFILE_ACTIVATION_UNSUPPORTED (profileRollout.ts activationUnsupported). It is a refuse-only vm/client/check gate that runs AFTER the unchanged NOT_READY readiness refusal. Today it is reachable only with readiness stubbed (test G4).

S1's iteration order already equals code-unit order, so the 'ids sorted ascending' contract is not independently pinned. If your whole-epic review hardens tests, add at least 2 strict open attempts whose iteration order differs from sorted order, and assert retainedStrictAttemptIds equals the sorted ids. The ids are random, so a few attempts make it fail reliably. Optional; no behaviour is wrong today.

comments.author: worker-c7cdb959
comments.content:
Doc gap for this row's docs sweep, routed from CQ-R13 (task-f4811a72, worker-c7cdb959). No doc says where a certified report lands for the daemon. Facts at 3761931b:
- A native `cli.mjs certify` run whose report is certified also files it in `<OS account home>/.moe/certification` (os.userInfo().homedir, never HOME or USERPROFILE). See scripts/local-runner/certify.mjs:190, which calls fileCertifiedReport (:141). A missing store directory is created 0700; an existing unsafe one is refused and never chmodded (realDir, :128). The file is created exclusively (`wx`, 0600, :103). On failure, certify writes one `{"code":...}` line to stderr (CERTIFY_STORE_UNSAFE, CERTIFY_STORE_WRITE_FAILED or CERTIFY_REPORT_INVALID) and changes nothing else; the work-dir report is already written by then.
- The daemon reads only that store: certificationStoreDir, then readHostCertificationEvidence, then readCertificationStore (packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/certificationEvidence.ts:113, :117, :164). Since CQ-M07c, the readiness evaluation's certifiedIsolation (executionReadiness.ts:223) gates isolated-agent-and-qa-vms and isolated-check-vm on it.
- A grep of docs/, CLAUDE.md and the subtree CLAUDE.md files finds no `.moe/certification`, fileCertifiedReport or CERTIFY_STORE_*. CQ-R13 kept to recording the two reports in docs/CERTIFICATION.md. Natural homes for this: CERTIFICATION.md's run and record sections, and docs/CONFIGURATION.md next to MOE_RUNNER_KEY_DIR.

Suggested wording: "launched as the verified local file (on Windows as `release:<pin sha256>`, whose reported image_hash must equal the pin)". Take it if it fits this row's docs scope; otherwise route it on.
